card.name: Space before weeks in lipid recheck timing
card.fires_on: The space right before a number of weeks or hours, in statin label text about when to recheck LDL-C or lipid levels (e.g. 'as early as' or 'within' then a number).

modes.label: Lipid recheck timing
modes.description: Space after 'as early as' or 'within' before a number of weeks, in statin monitoring instructions.
modes.example: Assess LDL-C when clinically appropriate, as early as<< >>4 weeks after initiating pravastatin

modes.label: Other timed follow-up
modes.description: Space before a number of hours in a timed follow-up dose.
modes.example: give Zestril 5 mg orally, followed by 5 mg after<< >>24 hours

card.writes: It pushes the model toward a number and away from time-span words like days, elapsed or timeframe, since the number comes next.
card.plain: It fires at the gap just before a number of weeks in statin instructions on when to recheck cholesterol.
